## MEETING NOTICE

Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 7pm
The meeting will be held at Beverly Police Department, Community Room
175 Elliott Street, Beverly, MA

These hearings are scheduled to be noticed to the public in the Salem News on 11/09/2026 and 11/16/2026

## NEW PUBLIC HEARINGS

**Mary Walsh**
requests a **Variance** for encroaching on left side yard setback to construct an ADU. The property is located at 553 Cabot St, Beverly, MA in the R10 zoning district.

**Kristin Parisella, Trustee, PAC1941 Irrevocable Trust**
requests a **Special Permit** to build a shed dormer over a portion of the front of the house. The property is located at 21 Cedar St, Beverly, MA in the R10 zoning district.

**Alexander Kwmuntis o/b/o Jon Connaughton**
requests a **Special Permit** to construct an attached ADU to the left side of house. The property is located at 20 East St, Beverly, MA in the R10 zoning district.

**Zakaria Mouhahe, o/b/o Paul & Diana Barr**
requests a **Special Permit** to convert the existing carport into an enclosed garage and construct 1 additional floor with attic space above the existing structure on the left side of the single-family residence. The vertical addition will remain within the existing building footprint, with a portion located within the required front yard setback. The addition's roof ridge will remain below the existing main roof ridge. The property is located at 19 Hale Park Ave, Beverly, MA in the R10 zoning district.

**William Nolan o/b/o Jonathan and Lisa Gawrys**
requests a **Special Permit** to extend an existing nonconformity to construct a covered entry porch and to construct a third story addition. The property is located at 12 Fosters Pt, Beverly, MA in the R10 zoning district.

**Atty. Thomas J. Alexander, o/b/o 386 Cabot St., LLC**
requests a **Finding** to build an addition to the existing commercial building on site which would accommodate 4 residential units. The existing commercial building is legally nonconforming since it directly abuts the railroad on one side and is set back 3.5 feet from the front lot line. The proposed addition complies with all setbacks, height, and parking requirements for this area. There is a bus stop for MBTA Bus #451 located on the curb in front of the property. The property is located at 386 Cabot St, Beverly, MA in the CN zoning district.

**Atty. Thomas J. Alexander, o/b/o Artur Metani**
requests a **Finding** to enlarge the pre-existing legally conforming single family house and a **Variance** to build an additional 3 family dwelling on site having the required parking on site of 10 spaces, built in accordance with setback and height requirements except that the front yard setback will be 12.6 feet and the resulting land area per unit will be 2003.8 sq. ft. per unit. The property is located at 15 Gage St. Beverly MA, in the RMD zoning district.

**Atty. Thomas J. Alexander, o/b/o Simboli Residential LLC**
requests a **Finding** to allow a 682 sq.ft. addition to the legally pre-existing nonconforming two family dwelling which is nonconforming due to the nonconforming existing side yard setback of 1.5 feet, front yard setback of 15.3 feet at their closest points, area of 7,559 sq.ft. and frontage of 60 feet where current zoning provides for 10 foot side yard, 20 foot front yard, 8,000 sq.ft. area and 65 foot frontage. The proposal would include 4 parking spaces, 2 for each unit as is required by the zoning district. The resulting building would be similar to much of the neighborhood and is an allowed use in the Residential Multifamily District where it is located. The property is located at 360 Cabot St, Beverly MA and is in the RMD zoning district.

## CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING

**Cellco Partnership d/b/a Verizon Wireless and the Towers, LLC**
requests a **Special Permit** under §§300-42 (C)(1)(p) and 300-91 height and setback **Variances** from §300-25A to permit a wireless communications facility with a monopole 124 feet in height (including 4'lightning rod) and setback from the property line of approximately 52'.
The property is located at 12 Tozer Road in the IR zoning district, Map 68, Parcel 25B.

## OTHER BUSINESS

A. Approval of October 28, 2026, Meeting Minutes (Cosmas)
B. Approval of September 23, 2026, Meeting Minutes (Cosmas)
C. Approval of 2027 ZBA Meeting Dates (Harris)
